name: 60 Wall Street atrium
reason: Kevin Roche POPS atrium being replaced by KPF redesign; lobby under renovation as of 2024; former tables/chairs not confirmed. Untapped (2024) calls it lost.

name: 120 Park Avenue atrium (former Whitney gallery)
reason: Posted closed 'until further notice' in 2021; building modernization began 2024; no evidence of reopening.

name: Trump Tower atrium (725 Fifth Ave)
reason: Unreliable public access: 2023-2026 reports of blocked connecting doors, early ejections, and garden closed per guard (April 2026).

name: NYU Paulson Center atrium
reason: NYU began requiring NYU ID to enter in spring 2024, effectively closing it to the public.

name: Ford Foundation atrium garden
reason: Open weekdays 11am-6pm but seating is only a perimeter bench and steps; no tables, unsuitable for laptop work.

name: 2 Lincoln Square enclosed plaza
reason: Enclosed plaza now used as a museum with two benches and a few chairs; no work seating.

name: 499 Park Avenue atrium
reason: Glass atrium with only a granite bench and planter ledge; no tables.

name: 899 Seventh Avenue through-block
reason: Indoor corridor; APOPS: no seats provided anywhere.

name: 1535 Broadway (Marriott Marquis) POPS
reason: No required seating or tables; 2024 visitor reports no public signage.

name: Mid-Manhattan Library (NYPL)
reason: Duplicate: rebuilt and renamed Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library (listed under that name).

name: Astoria Library (QPL)
reason: Closed for renovation; QPL expects reopening Summer 2029.

name: Court Square Library (QPL)
reason: Old One Court Square branch closed Feb 2020; new 5PointzLIC location leased 2025, still in design/construction, not open.
